title: Fix Android (Clang) build errors in the interruption subsystem
acceptance: Android arm64 Development build compiles with zero errors
description: Found packaging T-0006: Clang's -Wunreachable-code-loop-increment (an error on Android) rejects the 'for (...) return first;' pattern used to pick the first actor. MSVC accepts it, so the Windows editor build and tests never caught it.
